inj.c: Siegenthaler is dealing with an illness that could put his availability against the Habs on Wednesday in doubt, Amanda Stein of the Devils' official site reports.
Samuelsson (undisclosed) is considered a game-time decision for Thursday's road clash against the Capitals, per Paul Hamilton of WGR Sports Radio 550.
Robertson left Thursday's morning skate early, raising doubts regarding his availability against St. Louis, Seth Rorabaugh of Tribune-Review Sports reports.
Girgensons is considered day-to-day due to an upper-body injury, Lightning reporter Gabby Shirley reports Wednesday.
